title: Reproducible analysis code for OA-OC cross-disease transcriptomics
description: Configuration-driven analysis code supporting the manuscript Shared molecular features between osteoarthritis and ovarian cancer revealed by multi-layer transcriptomic analyses. The repository contains versioned workflows, dependency records, tests and source-data accession metadata for public GEO datasets.
